Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 27

“Actions are performed in every case by the qualities of nature. One whose self is deluded by ego thinks: I am the doer.”

The chapter's sharpest metaphysical turn. Krishna does not deny that things get done; he relocates the doing, leaving ego as a claim laid over a process already underway.
